sources.title: Andhra Pradesh Ground Water Department manual monthly water levels 2002-2026 (NWDP resource 7df4b96d), and its telemetry 2021-2030 (resources b57798f7, 0e97a298), used only to check which recorder is which
sources.publisher: National Water Informatics Centre, Ministry of Jal Shakti (National Water Data Portal)

provenance.note: Monthly mean depth below ground per well after the shared quality rules and the APWRIMS carried-forward, interpolation and spike rules. Wells are kept by coordinates in the IN-GRES unit polygons and named by the AP Water Resources Department mandal their coordinates fall in, never by tag; recorders are matched to NWDP telemetry by reading.

conventions.sign: depth_m_bgl is positive below ground; each feed's sign is taken from the well's own median, never abs()
conventions.aggregation: recorders: monthly mean of daily values, months with fewer than 5 good days left out; manual: one reading a month as read
conventions.comparability: a recorder and a manual well at the same site are different methods and are not spliced (see same_site_as)

well_type: Piezometers: daily recorders (APWRIMS) and manual monthly readings (AP Ground Water Department)
aquifer: Mostly unconfined, as the manual record tags its wells; we have not found an aquifer tag for the recorders
cadence_note: Wells marked 'recorder' are read automatically every day and shown as monthly means of at least five good days. Wells marked 'manual' are read by hand once a month, the oldest from 2002; readings from 2015 and earlier are history. At 27 sites a recorder and a manual well stand together, kept as separate series.
quality_note: Repeated values carried forward by the portal, straight-line gap fills, spikes, readings more than 20 m from a well's usual level and stuck sensors are removed before averaging.
source_label: Andhra Pradesh Water Resources Department (APWRIMS) and AP Ground Water Department via the National Water Data Portal (NWIC)
_note: Point wells, not an interpolated surface: 61 wells inside the 11 IN-GRES mandals, 30 daily recorders and 31 manual wells, 4454 monthly readings from 2002-05 to 2026-10. Readings from 2015 and earlier are history. 27 recorder and manual pairs stand at the same site and are kept as separate series. 3 manual wells whose published position falls outside the district are placed at their same-site recorder. 3 recorders carry different names in different station lists; they are flagged (identity_note) and not paired, and 1 more that NWDP places outside the district is left out.

_methodology.placement: kept by coordinates in public/geojson/visakhapatnam-gwr-blocks.geojson (ingres_unit); block is the mandal of APWRIMS:AP_MANDAL_V3 the coordinates fall in; a manual well at a recorder's site takes the recorder's block and ingres_unit
